results.title: Palestine 36
results.overview: Year 1936. As villages across Palestine rise against British colonial rule, Yusuf drifts between his rural home and the restless energy of Jerusalem, longing for a future beyond the growing unrest. But history is relentless. With rising numbers of Jewish immigrants escaping antisemitism in Europe and some arriving with nefarious Zionist-colonial ambitions, and the Palestinian population uniting in the largest and longest uprising against Britain’s 30-year dominion, all sides spiral towards inevitable collision in a decisive moment for the British Empire and the future of the entire region.

results.title: Kangaroo
results.overview: Ex TV personality, Chris Masterman, becomes stranded in an Outback town outside Alice Springs. There, he teams up with 12-year-old Indigenous girl Charlie. The pair form an unlikely friendship and work together to rescue and rehabilitate orphaned joeys in the remote but stunning Outback community—an endeavour that proves to be life-changing for them both.

results.title: Riba
results.overview: A young father, Sugi, once lived a peaceful life with his loving wife Rohmah, their two children Dimas and Bening, and his mother-in-law Lastri. Everything falls apart when Sugi gets trapped in a high-interest debt to a ruthless loan shark.  Under pressure and threats, Sugi gets involved in a dark ritual called “Getih Anak,” introduced by his old friend Muji. The ritual promises instant wealth, but every drop of blood spilled invites a real and binding curse. Soon, terrifying events begin to happen inside the house, haunting the whole family.  Not everything that looks easy brings blessing, and even a simple choice can have a heavy price. Now Sugi must face the consequences of his own fatal decision.

results.title: The Handyman
results.overview: A housewife's life unravels when she begins an affair with their handyman. As secrets emerge and suspicion grows, danger surfaces in this thriller where no one can be trusted.

results.title: 40 Acres
results.overview: Hailey Freeman and her family are the last descendants of African American farmers who settled in rural Canada after the Civil War. In a famine-decimated near future, they now struggle to safeguard their farm, as they make one last stand against a vicious militia hell-bent on taking their 40 Acres.

results.title: La Viuda
results.overview: Married to an elderly man widowed several times with lots of dirty secrets. Sophia became a victim of domestic violence. She’s determined to fight every step of the way. Will she succeed or end up with nothing?

results.title: Titan: The OceanGate Submersible Disaster
results.overview: OceanGate's Titan tourist submersible imploded in 2023 on a deep-sea dive to the Titanic. This documentary details how a bold vision ended in tragedy.

results.title: Obscura
results.overview: A forensic photographer hunts down an artistic serial killer despite facing his own demise.

results.title: Salomé
results.overview: AYT Senior present a complete performance of Oscar Wilde’s Salomé

results.title: Affinity
results.overview: Chilean martial-arts star Marko Zaror is Bruno, an ex-SEAL struggling with PTSD. He lives a life in fear of his demons until one day when he discovers a beautiful woman with no past of her own. Together they begin to build a life, but when she disappears, Bruno must return to his violent past if he’s going to save her from a shocking conspiracy.

results.title: Electoral Rage
results.overview: Marco, an 18-year-old, is preparing to vote for the first time in a presidential election. When a polarized runoff forces him to choose between two deeply unpopular candidates, he reluctantly supports the “lesser evil,” believing it’s the only way to protect his future and that of his girlfriend, Romina. But as the campaign intensifies and violent political rhetoric takes hold, Marco begins to change. Fear of losing Romina and the pressure of the moment push him down a darker path. He grows increasingly aggressive and intolerant, alienating his friends and ultimately driving Romina away. In the end, the outcome of the election no longer matters as he has already lost what mattered most.

results.title: Sem Break
results.overview: A group of friends sets out on a thrilling trip to Vietnam, but their adventure turns dangerous when one of them is found dead, sparking suspense, secrets, and unexpected tension.

results.title: Diabolic
results.overview: A woman's hope for a miracle cure turns into a nightmare when she confronts the vengeful spirit of a cursed witch, determined to claim her as a vessel for her evil power.

results.title: Golden Age
results.overview: Loud music, charismatic vocalists, broken guitars and drunk fans. The fervent and accepting Melbourne music scene in shown through local rock band Mindstain. Meet the magnetic members of the band. Encounter the sociable fans that thrive in the community. Feel the vigorous intensity that is the chaotic mosh pic. Hear the booming impassioned music and discover what makes this community so special.

results.title: Gaua (The Night)
results.overview: Spain, Basque Country, 17th century. At night and through the mountains, Kattalin escapes from her farmhouse and, while wandering through the deep forest, she senses a presence that stalks her.

results.title: Other
results.overview: Alice returns home after her mother's death to find the house unchanged-and haunted by a dark presence. As fear builds, buried trauma resurfaces, and a terrifying truth is revealed.

results.title: No Skate!
results.overview: The 2024 Paris Olympic Games. Isaac is a sandwich-board man. Cléo is a sandwich-board woman. One day, Isaac sees Cléo throw a skateboard into the water.

results.title: Sex Partner From a Blind Date App Who Helps Release Tension
results.original_title: Sex Partner From a Blind Date App Who Helps Release Tension
results.overview: Seo-yeon and Dong-seok had been trying to make their marriage work, but constant arguments and unresolved issues were driving them apart. One day, after a nudge from their friend Na-sung, they decided to give a dating app a try. Hoping to find some clarity or escape from their frustrations, they started meeting other people. Seo-yeon with other men, and Dong-seok with other women. What began as an attempt to fix their problems only seemed to push them further away from each other.

results.title: Valiant One
results.overview: With tensions between North and South Korea, a US helicopter crashes on the North side. The survivors must work together to protect a civilian tech specialist and find their way out without the help of US military support.

results.title: The World Will Tremble
results.overview: The incredible, untold true story of how a group of prisoners attempt a seemingly impossible escape from the first Nazi death camp in order to provide the first eyewitness account of the Holocaust.
